reason: The exact pool passed correctness and dispersion, but a 10-trial paired baseline did not prove the required zero latency regression. Closure-shaped adoption evidence has not been run.

structure.picker_contract: The existing date-specific demand picker still chooses the vehicles and routes. The standard pool is a deterministic post-picker layer keyed by date, demand build, route bytes, network, sensor targets and arm set.
structure.profile_distribution: normc-compatible truncated normal: mean 1.0, deviation 0.1, minimum 0.2, maximum 2.0
structure.common_random_numbers: Each arm's explicit per-vehicle factors are reused between its baseline and closure; XML load order cannot remap factors.
structure.departure_method: First match the original slots to robust passage windows; if that is impossible, use EDF feasibility and project each position toward the original global slot under the dispersion gate.

paired_baseline_timing.scope: 10 counterbalanced trials; three arms run concurrently; mesoscopic SUMO; sensor-only edgeData; no trajectories; no closure
paired_baseline_timing.p95_interpretation: Not adoption evidence: with only ten observations, nearest-rank p95 is the maximum and the source maximum was its cold first trial.

remaining_gates: A production-shaped paired baseline and representative closure benchmark with trajectories and exact semantic/health comparison.
A storage/materialization design that does not multiply closure filtering work or annual warm-cache size by three.
A declared bound on route-to-time reassignment in addition to the already-passing departure-spacing gate.
